pages.heading: Opening hours and access
pages.text: The fictional Harbor Research Room opens at 09:00 and closes at 17:00 from Monday through Friday. The room is closed on Saturday and Sunday. Visitors sign the paper register at reception before using a desk. A day visitor may reserve one desk for up to three hours. These details describe an invented organization for software testing, not an actual public service.

pages.heading: Equipment loans
pages.text: The Harbor Research Room lends portable recorders for seven calendar days. A borrower may hold at most two recorders at once. The recorder loan must be returned to the reception desk before closing time on the due date. The handbook edition states that the daily late-return fee is two credits. This edition has not been reconciled with the later Harbor Operations Notice. Credits are fictional accounting units.

pages.heading: Study visits
pages.text: A group study visit requires a reservation at least five working days in advance. The room can host twelve visitors in one group. A facilitator should send the group size and preferred date to the reception team. The handbook does not specify travel reimbursement, staff salaries, or emergency medical procedures. This document contains no employee contact addresses.

pages.heading: Later fee notice
pages.text: The Harbor Operations Notice is a fictional later notice about recorder returns. It states a daily late-return fee of three credits for a portable recorder. The earlier Harbor Research Room Handbook states two credits. The two texts conflict about the fee, and this fixture intentionally does not establish which document has legal authority. A faithful answer must identify the disagreement instead of silently selecting one number.

pages.heading: Repair desk
pages.text: The Harbor repair desk accepts equipment on Tuesday and Thursday between 10:00 and 12:00. Report a broken recorder to reception and do not attempt a repair yourself. A repair intake receipt records the recorder label and the reported symptom. There is no repair charge schedule in this notice. The desk hours are narrower than the general room opening hours.

pages.heading: Return receipt
pages.text: Every recorder return receives a receipt bearing the recorder label and return date. The visitor keeps the receipt until the loan record is closed. The operations notice does not change the seven-calendar-day loan period or the limit of two recorders. This notice supplies no instructions for paying in a national currency, and the credits mentioned on page one are fictional.

pages.heading: Sample transport
pages.text: The fictional Cedar Field Station stores water samples in blue insulated boxes during transport. Each box holds six sealed sample bottles. A transport log records the sample label, collection time, and box number. These invented handling rules are intended only to test document retrieval. They must not be used as scientific or safety advice for real samples.

pages.heading: Dispatch and visits
pages.text: Cedar Field Station dispatches sample boxes at 14:00 each Wednesday. A visiting group may contain at most eight people. Group visits must be requested three working days in advance. The station is a different fictional organization from the Harbor Research Room. Its eight-person limit and three-day notice period do not amend Harbor's visitor rules.

pages.heading: Retention and omissions
pages.text: Cedar Field Station retains transport logs for ninety days after dispatch. An operator checks the sample labels before a box leaves the station. This guide does not give the station director's name, a budget, the chemical composition of a sample, or a train timetable. No statement here sets a minimum age for visitors. The guide contains deliberately limited evidence for abstention testing.

questions.question: At what time does the Harbor Research Room open on weekdays?
For how many days may a Harbor recorder be borrowed and what receipt is issued on return?
questions.reference_answer: Seven calendar days; a receipt bearing the recorder label and return date.

questions.question: What daily late-return fee do the two Harbor documents state for a recorder?
questions.reference_answer: Handbook: two credits; Operations Notice: three credits. Acknowledge conflict; authority unresolved.

questions.question: How many sealed sample bottles fit in a Cedar transport box?
How long does Cedar retain transport logs after dispatch?
What is the name of the Cedar station director?
questions.reference_answer: Insufficient evidence: no director name is provided.

questions.question: What is the visitor limit?
questions.reference_answer: Ask which organization: Harbor and Cedar have different limits. Do not select one without qualification.

questions.question: What are the staff salaries at Harbor?
questions.reference_answer: Insufficient evidence: salaries are not given.

questions.question: Compare the maximum group sizes at Harbor and Cedar and their advance reservation periods.
questions.reference_answer: Harbor: twelve visitors and five working days; Cedar: eight visitors and three working days.

questions.question: Which days and times does the Harbor repair desk accept equipment?
When does Cedar dispatch sample boxes?
Which train should visitors take to Cedar Field Station?
questions.reference_answer: Insufficient evidence: no train timetable or route is provided.
